notes: Equipment hire is now one block on the quote instead of a row per hire. The heading carries the total and each piece of kit sits under it with its own price beside it, in the same cell. The invoice still gets a line per item, which is what an invoice wants. Extra charges can be reordered: small up and down arrows on each charge, greyed out at the ends, and the quote follows whatever order you put them in - the description and the amount travel with the row. And Vision Mixing on the quote now spells out the day rate on a job of more than one day, the way the crew rows do: 2 days x 500 pounds day rate, worked out from the fee and the dates, so there is nothing extra to keep up to date. A single-day job does not get the line, because the price already says it.
